title: Design System: Krogsveen Stil — Norway House & Land Seller Portal

body.purpose: High-legibility 18px+ labels and tabular NOK numerals (Albert Sans).

motion.name: auto-advance-step
motion.purpose: Smooth step transition after tapping a giant choice card.

components.name: Krogsveen Primary CTA Button
components.description: Krogsveen #B8C49E olive-sage conversion button with crisp #000000 text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; width: 100%; min-height: 78px; padding: 20px 28px; background: #B8C49E; color: #000000; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; border: 2px solid #5D726A; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #A6B489; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #5D726A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Giant Auto-Advance Tap Card
components.description: Zero-typing 18px+ bold choice card in Krogsveen #EDF0E7 / #DCE2CF sage tones.
components.css: .ds-tap-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; width: 100%; min-height: 84px; padding: 20px 24px; background: #EDF0E7; color: #000000; border: 2px solid #BFBFBD; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-tap-card:hover { background: #DCE2CF; border-color: #5D726A; } .ds-tap-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #5D726A; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tap-icon { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 8px; background: #B8C49E; color: #000000; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

narrative.overview: Modeled directly on the live color and typographic system of https://www.krogsveen.no/, pairing Krogsveen's calm Scandinavian botanical sage palette (#EDF0E7, #DCE2CF, #B8C49E, #5D726A) and editorial serif headlines with oversized zero-typing mobile ergonomics.
keyCharacteristics: Exact krogsveen.no palette: #FFFFFF ground, #EDF0E7 light sage, #DCE2CF mid sage, #B8C49E signature olive-sage CTA fill with #000000 ink, #5D726A deep pine-slate border accent.
Zero-typing interaction model across all 5 calculators and the 4-tap auto-advance seller funnel.
Minimum 1.125rem (18px) bold typography on all interactive controls with tabular-nums.
Custom 1.75px-stroke SVG architectural iconography with a strict ban on emojis.

rules.name: The Two-Pixel Pine Affordance Rule
rules.body: Interactive cards and inputs carry 2px solid borders (#BFBFBD at rest, #5D726A when selected or focused).

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings stand alone without eyebrow labels above them.

dos: Do use the exact krogsveen.no colors (#EDF0E7, #DCE2CF, #B8C49E, #5D726A, #292823, #000000, #BA5B3E, #FFF7D4).
Do use custom 1.75px-stroke SVG icons only (zero emojis).
Do keep type="tel" and inputMode="numeric" on the phone field and never ask for email.
donts: Don't use emojis or Unicode pictographs anywhere in the UI.
Don't include draggable map pins or keyboard typing inside any calculator.
